$ echo 'echo hello from $0 $1; whoami' > /tmp/s.sh; chmod +x /tmp/s.sh; /tmp/s.sh arg
hello from /tmp/s.sh arg
root
$ cd /tmp; ./s.sh
hello from ./s.sh
root
$ sh /tmp/s.sh x
hello from /tmp/s.sh x
root
$ sh -c 'echo inline $0 $1; exit 4' name one
inline name one
[exit 4]
$ echo 'echo piped' | sh
piped
$ chmod -x /tmp/s.sh; /tmp/s.sh
sh: /tmp/s.sh: Permission denied
[exit 126]
$ /tmp
sh: /tmp: Permission denied
[exit 126]
$ /nope
sh: /nope: not found
[exit 127]
$ echo 'sh /tmp/r.sh' > /tmp/r.sh; sh /tmp/r.sh 2>&1 | tail -1
sh: /tmp/r.sh: maximum nesting level exceeded

// BusyBox: every applet is the same binary, chosen by name.
$ ls -l /bin/ls /sbin/reboot /usr/bin/wget
lrwxrwxrwx 1 root root  7 Feb 10  2025 /bin/ls -> busybox
lrwxrwxrwx 1 root root 14 Feb 10  2025 /sbin/reboot -> ../bin/busybox
lrwxrwxrwx 1 root root 17 Feb 10  2025 /usr/bin/wget -> ../../bin/busybox
$ /bin/busybox echo via busybox
via busybox
$ busybox nosuch
nosuch: applet not found
[exit 127]
$ cp /bin/busybox /tmp/cat; /tmp/cat /etc/hostname
ipcam
$ ln -s /bin/busybox /tmp/curl; /tmp/curl
curl: applet not found
[exit 127]
$ ls --help
BusyBox v1.31.1 (2021-03-12 11:24:03 CST) multi-call binary.

Usage: ls [-1AaCxdLHRFplinshrSXvctu] [-w WIDTH] [FILE]...

// Binaries: an ARM one "crashes", one for another CPU fails like it would.

Segmentation fault
[exit 139]
$ printf '\177ELF\001\002\001\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\000\002\000\010' > /tmp/mips; chmod +x /tmp/mips; /tmp/mips
/tmp/mips: line 1: syntax error: unexpected "("
[exit 2]

[exit 139]
